name: ByteConn
description_en:
ByteConn presents a lightweight online inventory record for small online businesses. Its homepage describes incoming and outgoing stock, product details and visibility into better- and worse-selling items.

The documented scope is narrow. It can be evaluated as a structured product and stock ledger; the public page does not establish an automated order-management, warehouse-routing or accounting platform.
description_zh:
ByteConn 将自身介绍为面向小型线上商家的轻量在线库存记录工具。主页描述入库、出库、商品详情以及畅销与滞销商品查看。

已有文档范围较窄，可按结构化商品与库存台账来评估；公开页面没有确认自动订单管理、仓库路由或会计平台能力。

official_check.scope: Public official pages read and bilingual draft cross-checked; no account, purchase, execution, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: A practical trial would enter a small set of products with consistent identifiers, shelf locations and opening quantities, then record a receipt and a withdrawal. Compare the resulting counts with a physical count. This sequence is editorial guidance: the public page does not document detailed adjustment, reservation or approval semantics.
sections.zh: 实际评估可录入少量商品及统一标识、货架位置与期初数量，再记录一次收货和领出，并将结果与实物盘点比较。这是编辑建议；公开页未详细说明调整、预留或审批规则。

sections.title_en: Product limits are visible; billing cadence is not
sections.title_zh: 商品上限可见，计费周期不明
sections.en: The homepage lists Welcome at $0 for 500 inventory products, Starter at $9 for 1,000, Standard at $19 for 5,000 and Pro at $29 for 10,000. The text read does not state whether those paid amounts recur monthly, annually or on another basis. They should not be normalized into monthly prices. The pricing evidence is the homepage pricing section, not a separate tariff document.
sections.zh: 主页列出 Welcome：$0、500 件库存商品；Starter：$9、1,000 件；Standard：$19、5,000 件；Pro：$29、10,000 件。已读文字没有说明付费金额按月、按年或其他周期收取，因此不能换算成月价。价格证据来自主页价格区，非独立价目文件。

sections.title_en: Keep the comparison within documented scope
sections.en: Small teams replacing an informal stock list may find the product fields relevant. A merchant needing marketplace order imports, concurrent stock reservations, lot traceability or accounting posting should obtain documentation before choosing it. Best/worst-selling visibility is described, but calculation periods and treatment of returns are not explained on the public page.
sections.zh: 替换非正式库存清单的小团队可关注这些商品字段。若商家需要市场订单导入、并发库存预留、批次追溯或会计过账，应先获取文档。主页虽描述畅销与滞销查看，但未解释计算周期和退货处理。

sections.title_en: Resolve operating terms before relying on the ledger
sections.title_zh: 依赖台账前确认运营条款
sections.en: Sign-up and login links are present, but no account was created. Access roles, exports, backup recovery, API availability, long-term free-plan conditions and legal licensing were not established. These gaps limit procurement confidence even though the homepage supports the basic inventory description.
sections.zh: 页面提供注册和登录链接，但未创建账户。访问角色、导出、备份恢复、API、长期免费方案条件和法律许可均未确认。虽然主页支持基本库存描述，这些缺口仍限制采购判断的可靠程度。

research_gaps.en: Public documentation is thin; paid billing cadence, free-plan terms, integrations, permissions and export behavior remain unresolved.
research_gaps.zh: 公开文档较少；付费周期、免费方案条款、集成、权限和导出行为仍未解决。

research_gaps.en: No hands-on account, contract signing, integration, recovery or performance test was conducted; procurement terms and interface languages remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际登录账户、签署合同、运行集成、测试恢复或性能；采购条款和界面语言仍未核实。
